title: 蛟龍號深海科學潛器
summary: 以「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「水面浮力配置直接外推深海」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

stages.description: 單元1–2：深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳
stages.descriptionEn: Units 1–2: Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles
stages.route: 依序完成機制、估算、驗證與診斷；這是學習路徑，不是現場操作順序。
stages.routeEn: Complete mechanism, estimate, verification and diagnosis as a learning path, not an operating sequence.

steps.title: 單元1｜靜水壓差：機制與界面
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Hydrostatic pressure difference: Mechanism and interfaces
steps.objective: 以「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」完成機制與界面並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete mechanism and interfaces for Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」。畫出「水體基準 → 耐壓與浮力 → 定位或纜線 → 感測與供電 → 資料剖面」並圈出與「靜水壓差」有關的介面。將 density*9.81*depth 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：靜止流體壓差近似為密度乘重力加速度與深度差。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：未計絕對壓力、密度分層、壓縮性、動壓或殼體屈曲。
steps.instructionEn: The case focus is Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles. Draw Water reference → Pressure and buoyancy → Positioning or tether → Sensing and power → Data profile and mark the interfaces relevant to Hydrostatic pressure difference. Place every variable of density*9.81*depth on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: Static fluid pressure difference is approximately density times gravity times depth. Identify what it cannot establish: Excludes absolute reference, stratification, compressibility, dynamic pressure and hull buckling.
steps.observation: 對照「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」，輸入變數與量測結果不同：先定義可觀察量，再決定能否使用這個式子。前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
steps.observationEn: For Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles, distinguish inputs from observed outcomes before deciding whether this equation applies. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.
steps.failure: 水面浮力配置直接外推深海；未計絕對壓力、密度分層、壓縮性、動壓或殼體屈曲。
steps.failureEn: Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth; Excludes absolute reference, stratification, compressibility, dynamic pressure and hull buckling.
steps.check: 提交標註介面圖及變數表；每個變數有單位與假設/來源/量測標籤，並明列「未計絕對壓力、密度分層、壓縮性、動壓或殼體屈曲。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit the interface diagram and variable table with units and assumed/sourced/measured labels, explicitly recording: Excludes absolute reference, stratification, compressibility, dynamic pressure and hull buckling.

quiz.question: 使用「靜水壓差」前，哪個判讀符合此模型？
quiz.questionEn: Which interpretation respects Hydrostatic pressure difference?

不必區分模型輸入和現場量測。
未計絕對壓力、密度分層、壓縮性、動壓或殼體屈曲。
optionsEn: Any computed result proves the entire facility compliant.
Model inputs and field measurements need not be distinguished.
Excludes absolute reference, stratification, compressibility, dynamic pressure and hull buckling.

steps.title: 單元1｜靜水壓差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Hydrostatic pressure difference: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」的「靜水壓差」採以下合成教學值：density=1000 kg/m³；depth=2 m。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 density*9.81*depth；獨立基準為 19620 Pa。把 density 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 21582 Pa。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles, use synthetic inputs for Hydrostatic pressure difference: density=1000 kg/m³；depth=2 m. Check dimensions before evaluating density*9.81*depth; the independent benchmark is 19620 Pa. Increase density by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 21582 Pa. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: density增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 1962 Pa。未計絕對壓力、密度分層、壓縮性、動壓或殼體屈曲。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 1962 Pa. Excludes absolute reference, stratification, compressibility, dynamic pressure and hull buckling.
steps.failure: 水面浮力配置直接外推深海；未計絕對壓力、密度分層、壓縮性、動壓或殼體屈曲。
steps.failureEn: Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth; Excludes absolute reference, stratification, compressibility, dynamic pressure and hull buckling.
steps.check: 原值重算與 19620 Pa 相符；10%案例與 21582 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 19620 Pa at baseline and 21582 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（Pa）？
quiz.explanation: 按 density*9.81*depth 逐項代入，結果為 19620；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into density*9.81*depth gives 19620; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜靜水壓差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Hydrostatic pressure difference: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」設計「靜水壓差」的獨立驗證：用兩深度數位資料檢查壓差斜率，明確標示表壓與絕對壓。 用合成深度與時序資料核對壓差、浮力、定位和感測校正，不把模型當作耐壓認證。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles, independently verify Hydrostatic pressure difference: Check slope with two digital depths and distinguish gauge and absolute pressure. Check pressure, buoyancy, location and calibration using synthetic profiles; models are not pressure certification. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「水面浮力配置直接外推深海」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 水面浮力配置直接外推深海；未計絕對壓力、密度分層、壓縮性、動壓或殼體屈曲。
steps.failureEn: Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth; Excludes absolute reference, stratification, compressibility, dynamic pressure and hull buckling.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「未計絕對壓力、密度分層、壓縮性、動壓或殼體屈曲。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Excludes absolute reference, stratification, compressibility, dynamic pressure and hull buckling.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 保留原始資料並執行：用兩深度數位資料檢查壓差斜率，明確標示表壓與絕對壓。
只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
optionsEn: Retain raw data and perform: Check slope with two digital depths and distinguish gauge and absolute pressure.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「未計絕對壓力、密度分層、壓縮性、動壓或殼體屈曲。」。

steps.title: 單元1｜靜水壓差：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Hydrostatic pressure difference: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「水面浮力配置直接外推深海」。以本單元「靜水壓差」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「用兩深度數位資料檢查壓差斜率，明確標示表壓與絕對壓。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth. For Hydrostatic pressure difference, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Check slope with two digital depths and distinguish gauge and absolute pressure. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「水面浮力配置直接外推深海」不是單靠 19620 Pa 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 19620 Pa alone cannot exclude Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 水面浮力配置直接外推深海；未計絕對壓力、密度分層、壓縮性、動壓或殼體屈曲。
steps.failureEn: Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth; Excludes absolute reference, stratification, compressibility, dynamic pressure and hull buckling.
steps.check: 交付單元1的五項證據包；清楚寫出「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。

steps.title: 單元2｜排水浮力：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Displacement buoyancy: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」設計「排水浮力」的獨立驗證：以惰性數位模型分列重量與浮力，檢查排水量增大時的方向。 用合成深度與時序資料核對壓差、浮力、定位和感測校正，不把模型當作耐壓認證。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles, independently verify Displacement buoyancy: Separate weight and buoyancy in an inert digital model and check the direction of volume effects. Check pressure, buoyancy, location and calibration using synthetic profiles; models are not pressure certification. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「水面浮力配置直接外推深海」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 水面浮力配置直接外推深海；需另計本體、配重和纜線力；不等同姿態穩定或耐壓能力。
steps.failureEn: Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth; Body weight, ballast and tether forces remain; buoyancy is not stability or pressure capability.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「需另計本體、配重和纜線力；不等同姿態穩定或耐壓能力。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Body weight, ballast and tether forces remain; buoyancy is not stability or pressure capability.

optionsEn: Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.

steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Displacement buoyancy: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「水面浮力配置直接外推深海」。以本單元「排水浮力」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以惰性數位模型分列重量與浮力，檢查排水量增大時的方向。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth. For Displacement buoyancy, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Separate weight and buoyancy in an inert digital model and check the direction of volume effects. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「水面浮力配置直接外推深海」不是單靠 19.62 N 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 19.62 N alone cannot exclude Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 水面浮力配置直接外推深海；需另計本體、配重和纜線力；不等同姿態穩定或耐壓能力。
steps.failureEn: Surface buoyancy configuration extrapolated to depth; Body weight, ballast and tether forces remain; buoyancy is not stability or pressure capability.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「深潛器浮力、配重與能源帳」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Buoyancy, ballast and energy accounting in deep submersibles and retaining failed cases.
